intent: An ancient Grashan sun-priestess gown in pale ruin stone, sun gold, faded terracotta and plains green: a narrow gold-sashed bodice over dark slim sleeves and a stone skirt that steps out from a narrow hip to a green-lined terracotta hem, under a tall sun crown.
requests: A tapered skirt panel (a trapezoid rather than a box) would let the bell flare smoothly instead of in stacked tiers.
